stemMd: A jar has 5 white and 8 black beads. What is the minimum number that must be drawn without replacement to guarantee at least 3 white beads?
explanationMd: In the worst case all eight black beads appear before the third white. Eight plus three gives eleven draws. Ten can still contain only two white beads, so eleven is minimal.

distractorRationale.a: The first draws could all be black.
distractorRationale.b: Eight black beads could be drawn first.
distractorRationale.c: Eight black plus two white still fails the target.
distractorRationale.e: This guarantees it but is not the minimum.
